inbox.subject: Welcome to my portfolio!
inbox.body:
Hi there! Welcome to my portfolio's mail client.

If you'd like to get in touch, simply hit 'Compose' and drop me a message. Clicking send will open your device's native email app so you can reach me directly.

Looking forward to hearing from you!
